name: grokbot-mcp

tools.name: grokbot_agents
tools.description: List GrokBot agents on the account

tools.name: grokbot_team
tools.description: List agents with live running/idle/awaiting status

tools.name: grokbot_ask
tools.description: Send a prompt and wait until the Done Rule settles. Writes: changes state on a live GrokBot agent. Waits 45 s unless timeout is set; a pending result carries a job id, and grokbot_wait resumes it.

text.description: Message to send to the agent

timeout.description: Seconds to wait before giving up

agent.description: Agent name, slug, or agentId (defaults to GROKBOT_AGENT)

tools.name: grokbot_send
tools.description: Dispatch a message, or queue it while the bot is busy, and return a resumable job id. Writes: changes state on a live GrokBot agent.

text.description: Message to send to the agent

agent.description: Agent name, slug, or agentId (defaults to GROKBOT_AGENT)

tools.name: grokbot_wait
tools.description: Wait for a dispatched job id to finish

timeout.description: Seconds to wait before giving up

tools.name: grokbot_tail
tools.description: Read recent decoded transcript entries

limit.description: Number of recent entries to read

agent.description: Agent name, slug, or agentId (defaults to GROKBOT_AGENT)

tools.name: grokbot_interrupt
tools.description: Interrupt the active run on an agent. Writes: changes state on a live GrokBot agent.

agent.description: Agent name, slug, or agentId (defaults to GROKBOT_AGENT)

tools.name: grokbot_hire
tools.description: Create a bot with a role and its own /workspace/staff folder. Writes: changes state on a live GrokBot agent. Idempotent: calling it again with the same name re-briefs the bot it hired and keeps its instructions unless you pass new ones.

title.description: Job title shown under the bot's name

description.description: What the bot does; the opening of its brief

tools.name: grokbot_update
tools.description: Change a bot's title, description, or instructions. Writes: changes state on a live GrokBot agent.

title.description: Job title shown under the bot's name

description.description: What the bot does; the opening of its brief

tools.name: grokbot_fire
tools.description: Delete a bot or room. Destructive: deletes live GrokBot data; pass yes: true only after the owner approves.

yes.description: Confirm a command that changes or deletes live data

tools.name: grokbot_room_create
tools.description: Create a room where several bots answer one message. Writes: changes state on a live GrokBot agent.

member.description: Room member: bot name or agentId

tools.name: grokbot_room_members
tools.description: Set the bots in a room. Writes: changes state on a live GrokBot agent.

member.description: Room member: bot name or agentId

tools.name: grokbot_skills_list
tools.description: List the Box-wide (all bots) skill library, read through one bot. The skill library is Box-wide: every bot sees the same one.

tools.name: grokbot_skills_push
tools.description: Import a SKILL.md into the Box-wide (all bots) skill library; --replace --yes overwrites an imported copy. Writes: changes state on a live GrokBot agent. Pass the SKILL.md text as markdown. The library is Box-wide (all bots). Same name and content: no-op; different content needs replace and yes, which deletes the old copy for every bot.

markdown.description: The SKILL.md text, instead of a file

name.description: Skill name (default: the frontmatter name, else the file's folder name)

replace.description: Replace an imported skill of the same name whose content differs (needs yes)

yes.description: Confirm --replace, which deletes the old copy first

tools.name: grokbot_skills_remove
tools.description: Delete an imported skill from the Box-wide (all bots) skill library. Destructive: deletes live GrokBot data; pass yes: true only after the owner approves. Removes an imported skill for every bot (the library is Box-wide).

yes.description: Confirm a command that changes or deletes live data

tools.name: grokbot_skills_run
tools.description: Start an imported skill from the Box-wide (all bots) library on one bot (untested live). Writes: changes state on a live GrokBot agent.

tools.name: grokbot_routines_list
tools.description: List a bot's routines with trigger and next run

tools.name: grokbot_routines_enable
tools.description: Turn a bot's routine on. Writes: changes state on a live GrokBot agent.

tools.name: grokbot_routines_disable
tools.description: Turn a bot's routine off. Writes: changes state on a live GrokBot agent.

tools.name: grokbot_routines_delete
tools.description: Delete a bot's routine. Destructive: deletes live GrokBot data; pass yes: true only after the owner approves.

yes.description: Confirm a command that changes or deletes live data

tools.name: grokbot_routines_create
tools.description: Create a cron routine for a bot (untested live). Writes: changes state on a live GrokBot agent.

prompt.description: What the bot does on each run

tools.name: grokbot_approvals
tools.description: List open approval cards for one agent or every agent

agent.description: Agent name, slug, or agentId (defaults to GROKBOT_AGENT)

tools.name: grokbot_answer
tools.description: Answer or dismiss a bot's question widget. Writes: changes state on a live GrokBot agent. Pass value to answer the open widget, or dismiss: true to close it.

agent.description: Agent name, slug, or agentId (defaults to GROKBOT_AGENT)

card.description: Entry id of the card to act on (needed only when more than one is open)

dismiss.description: Close the widget without answering it

tools.name: grokbot_approve
tools.description: Approve an auto-review or local-tool permission card. Sensitive: acts with the owner's authority; pass yes: true only after the owner approves.

agent.description: Agent name, slug, or agentId (defaults to GROKBOT_AGENT)

card.description: Entry id of the card to act on (needed only when more than one is open)

always.description: Allow this action from now on, not just once

yes.description: Confirm a command that changes or deletes live data

tools.name: grokbot_deny
tools.description: Deny an auto-review or local-tool permission card. Sensitive: acts with the owner's authority; pass yes: true only after the owner approves.

agent.description: Agent name, slug, or agentId (defaults to GROKBOT_AGENT)

card.description: Entry id of the card to act on (needed only when more than one is open)

yes.description: Confirm a command that changes or deletes live data

tools.name: grokbot_computers
tools.description: List the computers registered to run bot requests

tools.name: grokbot_mcp_list
tools.description: List the Box MCP servers and their tool counts

tools.name: grokbot_mcp_call
tools.description: Call one Box MCP tool and print its result. Sensitive: acts with the owner's authority; pass yes: true only after the owner approves.

args.description: Tool arguments as a JSON object string

yes.description: Confirm a command that changes or deletes live data

tools.name: grokbot_vnc
tools.description: Open one live desktop window on the box (VNC). Writes: changes state on a live GrokBot agent. Opens the viewer on the host Mac.

window.description: Desktop window on the box; it selects the bot, e.g. 3 for Primary Test, 4 for Staff Test

tools.name: grokbot_worker_plan
tools.description: Show the exact worker command and env names without starting it

name.description: Display name for the worker (defaults to the hostname)
